limitations: the deformation is a heuristic rigid-body-plus-endpoint correction, so this screen tests its geometry, not anatomy, attachment or force
intersections are triangle-pair overlaps of closed surface meshes; they say nothing about which structure lies outside which
pairs that already intersect in the first frame are taken as the reference state, so the screen reports added penetration rather than absolute overlap
penetration depth is measured from intersecting face centroids to the other surface and is therefore an estimate, not a measured overlap volume
flips are judged against each muscle's own rigid body motion; a face that reverses relative to its neighbours without reversing against the bone is not counted
one standing registration with shared bounding-box centres and one subject's squat, right side only
